messages:
Harper (People Ops): Heads-up: two handbook changes went live this AM — (1) travel & expense reimbursement limits updated, and (2) conflict-of-interest disclosure form added. We need everyone to acknowledge both and complete the 10-min COI questionnaire by next Tue. :spiral_note_pad:
Evan (Finance): Reimbursement cap increased for domestic flights to $800 (coach). Receipts required for any meal >$25. Travel card users please note limit changes.
Liu (Hiring Manager): For candidates who had pre-approved travel reimbursements, do we retroactively apply new caps?
Harper (People Ops): Not retroactive. Pre-approvals remain as-is. Any exceptions going forward should route through Finance approvals.
Zoe (SWE): Do contractors need to submit the COI form? We've got a contractor on the payroll team.
Evan (Finance): Contractors with access to payroll/finance systems must submit COI. Others are optional but recommended.
Liu (Hiring Manager): Can managers do a bulk ack upload? If so, paste the CSV header.
Harper (People Ops): Yes — bulk upload allowed. CSV header below (add one row per person):
```manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,ack_travel,ack_coi,notes```
reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Travel & COI handbook ack" will post 72h and 24h before the deadline.
Zoe (SWE): If someone misses the COI questionnaire deadline and they touch sensitive data, what's the interim control?
Evan (Finance): We'll temporarily restrict certain system privileges and coordinate with their manager until completion. Notify Security via ticket labeled "COI-miss".
Harper (People Ops): Managers: checklist - 1) bulk upload CSV, 2) confirm receipts training link sent to teams, 3) track COI completions. I'll export a completion CSV after the window: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/ack_exports/travel_coi_1932.csv ./travel_coi_1932.csv```
Liu (Hiring Manager): Uploaded my CSV, marked one new hire as "TRAVEL_PREAPPROVED" in notes.
Harper (People Ops): Thanks! We'll flag preapproved in the report and exclude them from reminders. If any policy wording looks off, open a ticket and tag @Harper. Closing: canned manager reminder and short FAQ coming in #people-ops in 15m. :white_check_mark:
